title: Recursive block equivalence evaluation
statement: For every natural number $d$, sign vector $x\in\{−1,1\}^{3^{d+1}}$, and $i\in\text{Fin}(3)$, evaluating the block decomposition of $x$ at $i$ gives the vector of coordinates of $x$ in the $i$th block of length $3^d$.
hypotheses_covered: $x$ is a sign vector of length $3^{d+1}$
